notablePrerequisites: Lost Jitte has at least three charge counters on it.
easyPrerequisites: You control a basic Forest or Island.
description:
Activate a basic Forest or Island by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Gilder Bairn, untapping the basic Forest or Island.
Activate the Forest or Island by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Lost Jitte.
Activate Lost Jitte by removing a charge counter from it, untapping a land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat steps 5 and 6 one additional time.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Lost Jitte, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.
